title: Consciousness as Field Resonance: From Ego-Filtered Ontology to Differentiation-Dominant Dynamics
abstract: Consciousness is best understood as a resonant regime within a universal dynamical field. Empirical analysis of EEG under propofol sedation shows spectral differentiation (Omega) tracks conscious state with a double dissociation (Cohen's d = 1.50). The pre-registered multiplicative model C = Omega x kappa is falsified (F1). A differentiation-dominant, regionally constrained resonance model is supported.
